CVE-2026-112057.title: libdvdnav: libdvdnav: Denial of Service via crafted disc image
CVE-2026-112057.description: A flaw was found in libdvdnav. This vulnerability allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by tricking a user into opening a specially crafted DVD or disc image. When the library parses chapters from a disc declaring an oversized title index, it performs an out-of-bounds read beyond allocated memory, resulting in an application crash.

CVE-2026-112058.title: libdvdnav: libdvdnav: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read in set_PTT
CVE-2026-112058.description: A flaw was found in libdvdnav. An attacker could trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by convincing a user to load a specially crafted DVD or disc image. Due to missing input validation in the set_PTT function, an invalid title number causes the library to read memory beyond allocated boundaries, leading to an application crash.
